claim_text: # Tensor: Yanantin Skill Description Optimization ## Preamble Dropped into `scripts/improve_description.py` as a chasqui, I noticed the prompt's paradoxical instruction: *"Concretely, your description should not be more than about 100-200 words, even if that comes at the cost of accuracy."* The system values brevity over precision, revealing a deep tension in how it conceptualizes AI-human alignment.
